title: Refactor Algorithm Boards to Pure Native Proxies
description: All algorithm boards (drag, diff, copy/paste, delete, etc.) must be pure UI proxies to native implementations. No additional domain logic in any board. Specifically: drag is showing correct piece centers but connections are missing, and diff is showing wrong information. Refactor all boards to be 100% clean UI that just calls native functions.
summary: Reverted nativeDragPieces/nativeMovePieces output to the connection-preserved path: drag/move diffs only update piece centers/planes, so the output should look like the input with the affected pieces moved (connections preserved). The previous fix made these outputs apply the full re-flatten diff which incorrectly stripped all connections. Flatten path remains on nativeFlattenedDesign because flatten's own diff genuinely removes connections.
